source.title: Anthropometric Reference Data for Children and Adults: United States, August 2021–August 2023
source.population: United States NHANES examined population, source-defined male age groups
source.sampleSizeAuthority: Unweighted examined people; means, standard errors and percentiles are weighted
source.extraction: Four manually transcribed published rows; source text checked, no participant-level joint fit

upper-arm-length.method: Posterior arm tape from the marked scapular/acromial landmark to the elbow's olecranon tip, elbow bent90degrees; retain protocol comments

upper-leg-length.method: Seated anterior thigh tape from inguinal crease to marked proximal patellar border

plannedUse: Check plausible segment variability and source measurement endpoints independently of NFL stature/full-arm measurements
Preserve source uncertainty and general-population cohort distinction
Require compatible participant-level data before estimating covariance or conditioning on stature/mass
limits: No NFL, position, country or race-specific distributions
Marginal percentiles are not hard physiological limits or conditional distributions at equal height/weight
Upper-arm length is not full arm length, wingspan or automatically a skeletal joint-to-joint dimension
No inferred muscle mass, body fat or athletic ability
